title: WebSocket framing mask bit manipulation off-by-one in HTTP/2 multiplexed streams
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0607: WebSocket framing mask bit manipulation off-by-one in HTTP/2 multiplexed streams
Repository: `netty/netty`
Category: `High-Throughput Network Protocols`
Target File: `codec/http2/frame_decoder.c`

#### Problem Description
Payload length parsing fails to handle extended 64-bit length header when chunk arrives across TCP segment boundary.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Maintain stateful stream buffer and wait for full 8-byte extended length before parsing payload.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0607.py -q`
expected_invariant: Maintain stateful stream buffer and wait for full 8-byte extended length before parsing payload.
